name: Kolkata
air: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU)
plan: Allow two festival outings and a separate museum day. Choose your neighbourhood around the programmes you want to attend.
access: Ask pandal organisers about step-free entrances, quieter visiting hours and the distance from the permitted vehicle drop-off.

name: Mysuru
plan: Keep one day for the palace and another for the festival programme; add time if attending more than one major event.
access: Ask about accessible seating and the entry route for your particular Dasara event; palace access does not establish procession access.

name: Varanasi
plan: Keep the festival evening free and visit Sarnath on another day. Arrange a meeting point and return transfer in advance.
access: Ask for a route without ghat steps, the closest permitted drop-off and accessible toilets. Confirm boarding assistance before arranging a boat.

name: Jaipur
plan: Combine one festival day with two shorter sightseeing days; keep the event route separate from your sightseeing plan.
access: Ask each monument about lift or ramp access and which floors can be visited; confirm a suitable viewing area for processions.

name: Ahmedabad
plan: Reserve time for the booked festival programme and a separate heritage visit. Confirm the actual venue rather than assuming all events use the riverfront.
access: Ask the chosen garba or kite venue about step-free entry, seating, toilets and quieter sessions; rooftop access needs a separate check.

name: Mumbai
rail: Mumbai Central (MMCT); choose the station shown on your train booking
plan: Choose a compact area for each day and allow a separate outing for the festival. Keep return arrangements flexible around the announced event route.
access: Ask the event organiser about crowd-managed access and drop-off points. Confirm station lifts and assistance for the exact journey you plan.

name: Kochi
plan: Combine a confirmed Onam programme with a separate day in Fort Kochi and Mattancherry. Reserve any hosted meal directly.
access: If using a ferry, ask about boarding gradients and assistance at both jetties. Check step-free access to the selected meal or performance venue.

name: Udaipur
plan: Keep the festival programme and a palace visit on separate days; leave a spare half-day for changes to local arrangements.
access: Ask which palace areas can be reached without stairs and whether a step-free festival viewing point is available. Confirm boat boarding separately.

name: Amritsar
air: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport (ATQ)
plan: Allow time for the religious observance and a separate history-focused outing. Confirm the particular community programme before choosing dates.
access: Ask the gurdwara or event host about wheelchair routes, resting places and assistance with entry procedures; check museum access separately.

name: Hyderabad
rail: Hyderabad Deccan / Nampally (HYB); verify your booked station
plan: Keep one outing for the festival and another for the old-city sights. Confirm where the specific Bathukamma or Bonalu programme takes place.
access: Ask about accessible viewing areas, shade, toilets and transport drop-off points for the specific procession or gathering.

name: Guwahati
plan: Plan around a confirmed Bihu programme and allow a separate day for city sights. This base does not cover the whole of Assam.
access: Ask the performance venue about seating and step-free entry. Confirm temple access and queue assistance directly rather than assuming it matches the concert venue.

name: Khajuraho
plan: Pair one or two evening performances with daytime temple visits. Check the published running order before booking your stay.
access: Ask about step-free routes, accessible toilets and reserved seating at the actual performance site; temple steps may require an alternative viewing plan.

name: Mathura and Vrindavan
air: Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) is a regional arrival option; onward travel is required
plan: Choose the exact local Holi events first, then build transfer and rest time around them. Do not try to cover every Braj town in one day.
access: Ask the chosen temple or host about crowd controls, step-free entry, toilets and a quiet exit route. Confirm the last accessible vehicle drop-off.

name: Pushkar
air: Jaipur International Airport (JAI) is a regional gateway; onward travel is required
rail: Ajmer railway station for onward travel to Pushkar
plan: Choose the fair activities you want to see and allow time for the town and lake. Check the final programme before fixing your stay.
access: Ask about firm-surface routes at the fair, seating and accessible toilets. Confirm a route that avoids lake steps if required.

name: Puri
plan: Keep the main festival day free and consider Konark on another day. Confirm event access and entry rules before making plans.
access: Ask organisers for accessible viewing arrangements, toilets and drop-off points. Confirm temple entry rules and do not assume attendance at a public procession includes temple admission.
sources: District transport guide — Puri rail terminus

name: Kohima and Kisama
air: Dimapur Airport; onward road travel to Kohima and Kisama
rail: Dimapur railway station; onward road travel required
plan: Allow an arrival and transfer day, one or two festival days, and time in Kohima. Confirm road transfers and visitor requirements with official tourism services.
access: Ask the festival team about gradients, firm paths, accessible toilets and seating near the programme. Confirm vehicle access to your accommodation and the venue.
